'''Solk Horgon''', [[Parent/Legends|father]] of [[Seth Horgon]], was a [[Nerf/Legends|nerf]] rancher. After his son's murder, Solk accused [[Alchibi Des]] of the deed, and attempted to circumvent the local justice system by convincing [[Marshal/Legends|Marshal]] [[Jacobi Sterne]] to hang Alchibi without evidence or a trial. Failing that, Solk later returned to the Marshal's office, and engaged in a firefight in an attempt [[Death/Legends|kill]] Alchibi by way of armed mob. The Marshal, [[Malisan]], and Alchibi escaped the firefight through a secret tunnel.

==Behind the scenes==
Solk appeared in the role-playing sourcebook ''[[Far Horizons]]'' released in [[2014]] and developed by [[Sam Stewart]].<ref name="FH">''[[Far Horizons]]''</ref>
